_README: Render sizes per kind. Anima's template sets size through node 91 (ResolutionSelector), which is wired into the subgraph's width and height, so a 90.width or 90.height override never takes effect. 'expect' is the node's arithmetic: sqrt(megapixels x 1024 x 1024 x ratio), rounded to the nearest multiple. See art/DIRECTION.md, Settings. A 'tile' renders square; art/tools/make-tiles.mjs removes the wrap seam, maps it into the texture floors from brand_tokens.yaml and writes 512 x 512 WebP.

hero.tail: Full-bleed image from edge to edge, with no border or frame.

region.tail: Full-bleed image from edge to edge, with no border or frame.

tile.tail: A repeating surface with no border, frame or visible edge.

fibo._README: FIBO 2.0 sizes, on the Bria node's own aspect_ratio and resolution inputs (get_node BriaImageGenerate, 2026-11-03). The node picks the pixels; record the real size after the run.

fibo_space._README: FIBO 2.0 Dev sizes on Bria's Space briaai/Fibo-2.0-T2I: width 832 to 1344 in steps of 64, height 768 to 1248 in steps of 32, steps up to 50 (its app.py, read 2026-11-03). 1344 x 768 is the widest it takes; make-finals crops it to 16:9. The model card recommends 50 steps.
